Name: Iuscre Hoodies
Author: iuscre
Description:
This mod just made only for my own funtime so nothing serious.

You can get Iuscre Hoodies via tailoring so, to make it easier to get you can download Home Sewing Kit Mod to get your own sewing machine.

Recipes for Hoodies: 1Wool+1Grape = Iuscre Black Hoodie , 1Wool+1Oyster = Iuscre Gray Hoodie , 1Wool+1Beer = Iuscre Norway Hoodie

To see the Real Life Versions check - https://www.instagram.com/iuscreative (Iuscre Merch Page)

This mod still works with the 1.6 version but recipes might not be working.
So you can get these clothes with CJB Item Spawner: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93

Requiered Mods:

- https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
- https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720

Optional (Home Sewing Kit 30 Wood + 1 Iron)
- https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4935

THAT'S IT. HAVE FUN!
